title: Objective
description: What a reader is optimizing for, and which measurements are admissible evidence for it. Introduced by QUERIES.md §8.2: without this, the engine would answer a frontend-generation question with a repository-patching benchmark — fluently and wrongly. Construct validity becomes machine-enforced rather than editorially hoped for.

construct.description: What this objective actually is. Matched against each benchmark's declared construct; a mismatch makes the metric inadmissible.

metric_set.description: The only measurements admissible for ratio and frontier computation on this objective.

floor.description: Absolute normalization floor, NOT min-max across candidates. Min-max shifts every score when a weak candidate is added (RECOMMENDATION.md §7).

source_kinds.description: Admissible source classes for this metric.

coverage_floor.description: Below this share of the metric set, an entity is not_ratio_comparable. Partial measurement is never extrapolated.

implied_guards.description: QUERIES.md §8.4. Single-dimension maximization is almost always an incomplete reading of the question — maximizing autonomy alone selects for an agent that runs for hours producing an unmergeable diff. Guards are disclosed and overridable, never silent.

guard_disclosure.description: Shown to the reader whenever guards are applied. Required if implied_guards is non-empty.

dimension_affinity.description: Rubric dimensions this objective leans on for ordinal ranking, where no continuous metric exists.
